input.rationale: Index 15 (Sb 0.715) had the highest measured EQE, 0.00242%. Measured EQE was flat, about 0.002% from Sb 0.31 to 0.72, then fell to 0.0011% at Sb 0.865. XRD at indices 12 and 15 shows PbSb2O6 (mp-20727) as the best-matching phase (similarity about 0.47–0.49), plus extra peaks from an unidentified second phase. The final EQE measurement went to index 12, the peak predicted by a quadratic fit and by the GP, but it came in lower at 0.0020%.

content.text:
I submitted index 15 (Sb fraction 0.715) as the best composition. At 0.00242% EQE it had the highest reading of the five measurements.

EQE was low and nearly flat across the Pb-Sb-O line, so the lead is small:

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0.307 | 0.00192 |
| 9 | 0.523 | 0.00229 |
| 12 | 0.626 | 0.00200 |
| **15** | **0.715** | **0.00242** |
| 22 | 0.865 | 0.00108 |

- **Final measurement:** I spent the last EQE measurement on index 12, where both a quadratic fit and the Gaussian-process model put the peak. It came in lower (0.00200%), so that prediction was wrong.
- **XRD:** I measured indices 12 and 15. The closest match was PbSb₂O₆, the known phase at Sb 0.667, with a similarity of only about 0.47–0.49. Extra peaks point to a second phase that I didn't identify.
- **Unmeasured:** The 0.72–0.85 Sb range between indices 15 and 22 was never measured, so a better composition could be there. The budget left no room to check it. I used 2 of 5 XRD measurements and all 5 EQE measurements.
